Publications about ProVerif

ProVerif is continously being improved.

The first version of ProVerif was published in 2001. Over time, it continuously received updates while preserving backwards-compatbility. The last major update added restrictions, axioms and lemmas, which further improved the scope of protocols that can be proven.
